description: Proceeds From Broker and Barter Exchange Transactions — one document per Form 8949 section (A–F), reporting the section subtotals printed at its foot. Per-lot rows are not extracted in v1; the section is attached for the preparer to read (§9).

fields.label: Form 8949 section (A–F) printed in the heading
fields.notes: A/B/C short-term, D/E/F long-term; reported vs not reported vs no 1099-B. Drives Schedule D.

fields.label: Number of lots (transactions) in this section
fields.notes: Printed on many brokerage packages as a count; blank when not printed. Never computed here.

fields.label: Section subtotal — cost or other basis (box 1e)
fields.judgmentReason: Missing or noncovered basis cannot be resolved from the form (§9).

fields.label: Section subtotal — wash sale loss disallowed (box 1g)
fields.judgmentReason: Wash sale adjustment requires preparer review (§9).

fields.label: Section subtotal — gain or loss, as printed
fields.notes: Only when the package prints it. Never computed here.

fields.label: Noncovered security
fields.judgmentReason: Noncovered security: basis not reported to the IRS (§9).
